function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check whether a day, or an exact time, is open. Returns open times, or the nearest alternatives when the time is taken or the shop is closed.

when.description: The caller's own words for the day and time, e.g. 'next Tuesday at 2pm' or 'tomorrow morning'. Pass them unchanged; never work out a date yourself.

mechanic.description: Dana, Luis or Priya, only if the caller asked for one. Empty means anyone.

function.name: create_booking
function.description: Book an appointment. Only call this after reading the day, time and mechanic back to the caller and hearing them say yes.

when.description: The caller's own words for the day and time, e.g. 'next Tuesday at 2pm' or 'tomorrow morning'. Pass them unchanged; never work out a date yourself.

mechanic.description: Dana, Luis or Priya, only if the caller asked for one. Empty means anyone.

email.description: Email address for the confirmation, if the caller gave one. Empty if not.

function.name: reschedule
function.description: Move the caller's existing appointment to a new time. Read the new day and time back to the caller first.

when.description: The NEW day and time, in the caller's own words.

booking_id.description: The booking number, if the caller knows it or a previous answer gave it. 0 if not.

mechanic.description: Dana, Luis or Priya, only if the caller asked for one. Empty means anyone.

function.name: cancel
function.description: Cancel the caller's appointment. Confirm with the caller first.

booking_id.description: The booking number, if the caller knows it or a previous answer gave it. 0 if not.

function.name: request_callback
function.description: Ask a staff member to call the caller back: they want a person, need something these tools can't do, or a tool failed.

reason.description: One sentence on what the caller needs.
